notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Naru Meha.
description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Naru Meha by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
